name: Hibiki Ryouga
source: Though usually appearing as Akane's pet P-chan, his true identity is Ranma's rival—a boy cursed to transform into a black piglet when splashed with water. Though he harbors feelings for Akane, his awkwardness keeps him from confessing them openly.
